'''The Dancers''' are a group of hills in [[Altara]], named so during the time of [[Londaren Cor]], capitol city of [[Eharon]], a nation of the time of the [[Ten Nations]], which was situated on the site. The hills are described as three tall hills in a row: "The middle hill had a cleft top, like a wedge cut cleanly out, while the hill on the left had two.”{{ref/book|11|8}}
